data.label: Invoice intake, review and approved delivery
data.description: Proposed composed delivery unit on Google Cloud Run: browser/API, background worker and isolated PDF/OCR parser. Owns Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL transactional queue/outbox and review state, private versioned Google Cloud Storage originals, regional Vertex AI extraction, staff sign-in, SQL user/reviewer membership and separate keyless workload identities. Returns supplier, invoice date, total, currency, source evidence and processing status in the review UI. Parser alone sees untrusted PDF bytes and has no database, model or accounting identity. Persist intake identity and results; commit state and queued work atomically, fence worker leases and recover stalled work. Bind approval to the exact source/result revision and destination contract; edits invalidate approval. Send only approved payloads using a durable operation ID and stable payload identity. Retry only within a verified accounting idempotency contract; uncertain outcomes pause for reconciliation rather than creating a new send. Owns bounded retries, audit events, monitoring, alerts, retention and restore/reconciliation operating tasks. Proposed defaults: PDFs up to 10 MB/100 pages and 90-day retention eligibility, subject to backup/version-window review. Required boundary: documents and extracted data remain stored and processed in Australia, including temporary parser data, model requests/results, sensitive logs, database backups, object versions and recovery copies. Sydney (australia-southeast1) is proposed, not accepted or verified. Verify Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, storage, selected Vertex AI model, private networking, quotas, processing geography and zonal recovery before implementation approval. Do not silently use global model endpoints, overseas replication or overseas failover. Model retention/caching/logging policy, staff identity/access geography and accounting residency/adapter acceptance remain unresolved. This capability is not evidence of deployment or combined-system validation.

data.label: Existing accounting API
data.description: Client-owned existing accounting service; reference only, never recreated or modified by this design. Receives only reviewer-approved invoice payloads. Its adapter must independently pass normalized-action-v1 acceptance for authentication, schema, durable idempotency, stable operation/payload identity and outcome reconciliation. Native vendor compatibility and deployment location are unknown. Australian storage and processing of submitted invoice data must be established before enabling delivery; do not assume the existing service satisfies the residency boundary.
